# Totality

> Totality records which agent session produced each Git commit and uses that context for AI code review and generated pull request summaries. You work in plain Git.

## Docs

- [How it works](/docs/how-it-works): What Totality captures, how tx review and PR summaries use it, and why that makes review faster.
- [Getting Started](/docs): Install Totality, initialize a repository, and publish your first reviewed change.
- [CLI](/docs/cli): CLI Reference with flags, examples, and exit codes.
- [MCP](/docs/mcp): Connect the Totality MCP server to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other MCP clients.
- [Pull Requests](/docs/pull-requests): Generated PR summaries in the pull request description, and @tx chat inside PR comments.
- [Totality changelog: new features, updates, and fixes](/docs/changelog/overview): Changelog for Totality covering new features, product updates, CLI improvements, review workflow changes, and bug fixes.
